div.head: Northu 36
div.ab: Gif preost on gesetne timan tída ne ringe oððe tida ne singe, gebete þæt.
Gif preost on gesetne timan tida ne ringe oððe tida ne singe, gebete þæt.
Wenn ein Priester nicht zur festgesetzten Zeit Hore(n?) läutet oder nicht Hore(n?) singt, büsse er das.
If a priest does not ring the hour(s) at the appointed time or does not sing the hour(s), let him atone for it.
If a priest does not ring the hours or sing the hours at the appointed time, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest does not ring or sing the canonical hours at the set time, he is to atone for that.
